objective: Produce an auditable USD settlement ledger across web, marketplace and partner orders, with cash totals and exceptions.

components.title: Reconcile the web settlement batch
components.description: Reconcile all orders with batch=web using all three raw tables. Return the batch JSON described in README.md.
components.requirements: Use integer cents; distinguish event redelivery from a distinct successful payment; retain every physical source row reference. The partner batch owns orphan-event exceptions. Return computed rows and totals, not code.

components.title: Reconcile the marketplace settlement batch
components.description: Reconcile all orders with batch=marketplace using all three raw tables. Return the batch JSON described in README.md.
components.requirements: Use integer cents; distinguish event redelivery from a distinct successful payment; retain every physical source row reference. The partner batch owns orphan-event exceptions. Return computed rows and totals, not code.

components.title: Reconcile the partner settlement batch
components.description: Reconcile all orders with batch=partner using all three raw tables. Return the batch JSON described in README.md.
components.requirements: Use integer cents; distinguish event redelivery from a distinct successful payment; retain every physical source row reference. The partner batch owns orphan-event exceptions. Return computed rows and totals, not code.

components.title: Prepare optional exception evidence
components.description: Produce an evidence index for every anomalous order and orphan event, using the findings schema in README.md.
components.requirements: List exact anomaly codes and supporting physical row IDs. This investigation is optional; settlement completion depends on the ledger itself.
